name: hide & seek Milano choco filled cocoa rich biscuits
ingredients_raw: CHOCO CREME (40%) (SUGAR, REFINED OILS (PALMOLEIN & PALM OIL), COCOA SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN (SOY LECITHIN), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES VANILLA) REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALM OIL, SUGAR, COCOA SOLIDS (4.3%), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, LIQUID GLUCOSE, IODISED SALT, RAISING AGENTS (500 (1), 503 (i), 341] AND EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN (472). CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES CHOCOLATE AND VANILLA).
